mapper.select: select date_format(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as day, sum(case when type = 'lost' then 1 else 0 end) as lost, sum(case when type = 'found' then 1 else 0 end) as found from item where create_time >= date_sub(curdate(), interval 6 day) group by day order by day

select c.category_name as name, count(i.item_id) as value from category c left join item i on i.category_id = c.category_id group by c.category_id, c.category_name order by value desc, c.category_sort
